updates.content:
Title: Users are unable to view or manage device group configurations through the Microsoft Defender portal.

User impact: Users are unable to view or manage device group configurations through the Microsoft Defender portal.

Current status: We're investigating a potential issue with Microsoft Defender portal and checking for impact to your organization. We'll provide an update within 30 minutes.

Title: Users and admins can't view or manage device group configurations through the Microsoft Defender portal

User impact: Users and admins can't view or manage device group configurations through the Microsoft Defender portal.

More info: The device groups page in the Microsoft Defender portal isn't loading for affected users and admins. Core security operations such as detection, alerting, and incident response aren't affected.

Current status: We've identified that an issue in the device groups page is causing a component in the page rendering process to fail to handle the response correctly and is resulting in the page to crash. We're working on developing a solution that remediates the impact.

Scope of impact: Users and admins attempting to view or manage device group configurations through the Microsoft Defender portal may be affected. This section may be updated as our investigation continues.

Root cause: An issue in the device groups page is causing a component in the page rendering process to fail to handle the response correctly and is resulting in the page to crash.

Next update by: Monday, October 19, 2026, at 9:00 PM UTC

Title: Users and admins couldn't view or manage device group configurations through the Microsoft Defender portal

User impact: Users and admins couldn't view or manage device group configurations through the Microsoft Defender portal.

More info: The device groups page in the Microsoft Defender portal wasn't loading for affected users and admins. Core security operations such as detection, alerting, and incident response weren't affected.

Final status: Our investigation has further determined it was specifically a code issue that was occurring within the device groups page and caused a component in the page rendering process to fail to handle the response correctly and resulted in the page to crash. We've developed and deployed a fix to remediate the impact and confirmed with some affected users that the issue is resolved.

Scope of impact: Users and admins who attempted to view or manage device group configurations through the Microsoft Defender portal may have been affected. 

Start time: Monday, October 19, 2026, at 9:00 AM UTC

End time: Monday, October 19, 2026, at 7:51 PM UTC

Root cause: A code issue in the device groups page was causing a component in the page rendering process to fail to handle the response correctly and was resulting in the page to crash.

Next steps: 
- We're investigating the code issue to pinpoint why it wasn't caught during the testing and validation phase so that we can prevent impact to viewing or managing device group configurations through the Microsoft Defender portal in the future.

This is the final update for the event.
